NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Tripfold uses your photo library to pick booking screenshots and trip photos.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Tripfold uses the camera to scan receipts and boarding passes.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Tripfold uses your location to show where you are on the trip map.
NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Tripfold uses Face ID to open your important documents (such as passport copies).
